entities.name: Greven il-Vec
entities.description: A former en-Vec warrior turned Phyrexian-enhanced commander of the skyship Predator and Volrath's second-in-command, who dies fighting Tahngarth aboard Weatherlight.

entities.name: Volrath
entities.description: The evincar of the Stronghold who controls Greven through a mimetic spine and later returns to reclaim his title.

entities.name: Predator
entities.description: The Stronghold's flagship skyship commanded by Greven.

entities.name: Weatherlight
entities.description: The skyship of Gerrard's crew, which carries the Legacy artifacts and repeatedly fights Predator.

entities.name: Gerrard Capashen
entities.description: A Weatherlight crewmember whom Volrath wants brought to the Stronghold; he evades Greven repeatedly.

entities.name: Vhati il-Dal
entities.description: Greven's first officer, who tries to assassinate him and is thrown overboard.

entities.name: Sisay
entities.description: The captain of Weatherlight, whose kidnapping prompts the rescue mission.

entities.name: Tahngarth
entities.description: A minotaur who stows aboard Predator, is captured and partly mutated by Greven, and later kills him.

entities.name: Crovax
entities.description: A candidate for evincar who controls Greven's mimetic spine and is crowned evincar after beating Volrath in a duel.

entities.name: Belbe
entities.description: The Phyrexian emissary who selects Volrath's successor.

entities.name: Ertai
entities.description: A captive mage who keeps Predator aloft, devises the hostage plan and interferes in the duel for Crovax.

entities.name: Eladamri
entities.description: The elvish rebel captured and tortured by Greven.

entities.name: Furah
entities.description: A Kor leader who betrayed Eladamri; revealed to be Volrath in disguise.

entities.name: The Stronghold
entities.description: The Phyrexian fortress on Rath ruled by the evincar.

entities.name: Rath
entities.description: The plane whose armies Greven commands.

entities.name: Skyshroud
entities.description: The forest of the rebels that Predator bombards.

entities.name: Erratic Portal
entities.description: A portal through which Weatherlight escapes Predator, closing behind it.

entities.name: Rathi Overlay
entities.description: The event that brought the Stronghold to Urborg.

entities.name: Urborg
entities.description: The place where Weatherlight attacks the newly arrived Stronghold.

entities.name: En-Vec
entities.description: The human tribe to which Greven once belonged.

events.summary: Greven abandons his people and joins the Stronghold's oppressors, becoming il-Vec and rising to command Predator.
events.quote: Greven turned his back on his people and joined their oppressors

events.summary: Volrath orders Greven to intercept Weatherlight and bring back the Legacy artifacts and Gerrard.
events.quote: the evincar Volrath entrusted Greven with a crucial mission

events.summary: Predator ambushes Weatherlight and overpowers its crew.
events.quote: Predator caught it by surprise, boarded it, and soon overpowered its crew.

events.summary: Greven captures Gerrard, but Vhati's attempt to assassinate Greven knocks Gerrard overboard.
events.quote: Vhati missed, but the impact knocked Gerrard overboard into the forest below.

events.summary: Greven throws Vhati overboard and returns to the Stronghold with the artifacts.
Greven begins mutating the captured Tahngarth into a Phyrexian as a replacement for Vhati.
events.quote: Greven, therefore, began mutating the minotaur

events.summary: Weatherlight smashes Predator into the Stronghold, then escapes through the Erratic Portal and Predator crashes into the rock face.
events.quote: Unable to stop in time, Predator smashed into the rock face, sustaining heavy damage.

events.summary: Volrath has vanished and the Stronghold falls into chaos; Greven takes charge and meets candidate Crovax and emissary Belbe.
events.quote: the evincar had disappeared, throwing the rest of the Stronghold into chaos.

events.summary: Greven and Crovax fight and Crovax uses the mimetic spine to lay Greven low.
events.quote: Crovax had worked out how to control Greven

events.summary: Greven turns down Belbe's offer to be considered for evincar, preferring to be the sword rather than the hand.
events.quote: Greven turned down the offer, saying he had seen what having such power turned its bearer into.

events.summary: Ertai proposes taking 5,000 hostages from the human communities to prevent rebellion, and Greven rounds them up.
events.quote: Ertai came up with the plan to take 5,000 hostages from the three human communities

events.summary: Crovax returns to the Stronghold and slaughters all the hostages.
events.quote: Crovax had survived and had teleported back to the Stronghold, where he had discovered the hostages and slaughtered every last one of them.

events.summary: Greven tortures the captured Eladamri but cannot break him.
events.quote: However, Greven was unable to break him.

events.summary: Furah reveals himself to Greven as the returned Volrath.
events.quote: Greven was stunned when Furah revealed he was Volrath, who had returned to reclaim his title.

events.summary: Greven interrupts Crovax's coronation, Volrath resumes his true form, and Crovax defeats him in a duel after Ertai interferes.
events.quote: Ertai interfered by magically off-balancing Volrath, allowing Crovax to triumph.

events.summary: Predator intercepts Weatherlight at Urborg; Greven's mind is dominated by Crovax and Tahngarth kills him.
events.quote: Greven soon fell beneath the raging minotaur

relations.quote: the man in command of the skyship Predator

relations.note: Greven tries to capture Gerrard and fights him again.
relations.quote: Greven briefly left the vessel to fight a rematch against Gerrard

relations.note: Throws his first officer overboard; Vhati is later called deceased.

relations.quote: Greven soon fell beneath the raging minotaur

relations.note: They clash and Crovax controls Greven's spine.
relations.quote: Greven and Crovax got into an argument that quickly descended into a fistfight.

relations.note: They duel over the evincarship and Crovax wins.
relations.quote: Belbe simply proposed a duel between Crovax and Volrath to settle the dispute.

relations.note: The Stronghold is the fortress of Rath's armies.
